editorial.blurb: This beloved Chicago breakfast spot has earned its TikTok fame with enormous portions, impeccable service, and dishes that reviewers call 10/10.
editorial.insiderTip: Make a reservation—the place gets packed with 2-hour waits—and you'll be seated promptly; ask your server (Josh and Amy get special mention) for recommendations, and come hungry.
signatureDishes: Fried catfish and grits with shrimp
